visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a brown coat and a black beanie, is seen in front of a digital backdrop of Japanese torii gates. She is holding a smartphone high as if taking a selfie, smiling broadly with her mouth open. (2) The scene shifts to the same woman in front of a Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion) background. She looks down at her phone with a confused and frustrated expression, then reaches out her hand as if searching for a cellular signal. (3) The woman is now in an indoor studio setting with a bright background. She is wearing a patterned brown and orange sweater and the same black beanie. She speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with her hands to emphasize her points. A logo for 'DJB' is briefly overlayed near her head. (4) A graphic of a 'DJB' SIM card product package titled '暢日卡' appears, featuring a minimalist design with a red sun symbol. (5) A stylized animation of a SIM card flying through a starry, purple space background is shown. (6) The woman in the studio holds up a purple smartphone, pointing to the screen which displays the beginning of an eSIM setup process. (7) A screen recording shows a laptop screen with a QR code, followed by a close-up of a smartphone screen where a user scans the code and confirms the activation of a new eSIM. (8) Back in the studio, the woman holds a physical SIM card and its credit-card-sized holder, comparing it to her phone. (9) A graphic appears showing various pickup methods like home delivery, 7-Eleven, and airport counters. (10) The woman holds a bundle of black cables near her face, speaking with wide eyes and animated expressions. (11) She is then seen wearing professional black gaming headphones with a microphone, sitting in front of a laptop and pretending to type, representing customer service. She smiles and nods while looking at the screen. (12) The video concludes with the woman in the studio, gesturing excitedly with both hands near her face, smiling warmly at the viewer.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female presenter appearing throughout the video.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long brown hair and bangs. She is seen in two main outfits: a beige/brown overcoat with a black beanie, and later a brown and orange patterned sweater with the same beanie.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video uses digital overlays of famous Japanese landmarks (Fushimi Inari torii gates, Golden Pavilion) for the 'traveling' segments, and a clean, brightly lit indoor studio background for the 'talking head' presentation segments.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a bright, high-tempo electronic pop BGM. A cheerful young female voice begins speaking quickly and clearly about traveling. The studio-clean recording captures every sharp articulation. (2) A soft 'pop' SFX triggers as the first logo appears. The BGM remains steady at approximately 128 BPM with a strong, four-on-the-floor kick drum. (3) The speaker's tone shifts to a slightly exaggerated, frustrated 'tourist' persona while discussing roaming issues. A 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the transition between scene segments. (4) The primary narrative voice returns with an authoritative yet welcoming tone, detailing 'DJB' product features. Multiple digital UI 'clicks' and 'dings' are heard as on-screen text and screen recordings update. (5) A rhythmic 'ding-ding' sequence marks the listing of product benefits. The BGM tempo remains consistent, providing a high-energy pulse beneath the narration. (6) A short, melodic 'sparkle' SFX sounds as the speaker mentions 'backup lines'. Her pitch rises momentarily for emphasis. (7) A brief moment of vocal playfulness occurs as the speaker says 'Annyeonghaseyo' with a sharp, rising intonation. (8) The video ends with a warm closing statement and a quick fade-out of both the BGM and the vocal track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Features -> Support -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comprehensive advertisement for DJB's international SIM and eSIM cards, specifically targeting Taiwanese travelers to Japan. It uses a problem-solution narrative to address common issues like roaming signal loss and data caps, presenting DJB as the superior choice with unlimited data and multi-language customer support.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the product, brand logo prominently displayed, detailed explanation of service benefits, and a clear call to action regarding the brand.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes high-density text overlays and fast-paced editing typical of social media marketing to maintain viewer engagement while conveying a large amount of technical product information.
